# Far Cooler wrote and manages this block.
# Each Host below is a runner. One with a ProxyCommand is reached through Far Cooler's tunnel.
# Far Cooler removes a tunneled runner's entry when you remove that runner.
# @ALIAS@: a runner reached through the Far Cooler tunnel
Host @ALIAS@
  ProxyCommand @PROGRAM@ runner pipe @ID@
  HostKeyAlias farcooler-@ID@
  KnownHostsCommand @PROGRAM@ runner known-host @ID@ %I '%H' %t %K
  UserKnownHostsFile /dev/null
  GlobalKnownHostsFile /dev/null
  StrictHostKeyChecking yes
  UpdateHostKeys no
  User @USER@
  IdentityFile /@IDENTITY@
  IdentitiesOnly yes
